name: cURL to Code
description: Convert curl commands into fetch, Python, Go, Rust, Java, PHP and C# code
help: Paste a curl command, including the ones copied from browser DevTools with “Copy as cURL” in bash or cmd format.
Headers, methods, -d / --data-raw / --data-binary / --data-urlencode / --json bodies, -F multipart forms, -G, -u, -b, -k, -L, -m, -x and --compressed are converted.
JSON bodies are pretty-printed into readable literals; every other body is kept byte for byte.
Options that cannot be converted are listed below the command so nothing is dropped silently.

warnings.title: Not converted
warnings.curl.upload_unsupported: Uploading a file with -T ({{path}}) is not converted
warnings.curl.cookie_file: Reading cookies from the file {{path}} is not converted
warnings.curl.multiple_urls: The command has {{count}} URLs; only the first one is used
warnings.curl.data_and_form: -d and -F cannot be combined; the -d data was dropped
warnings.curl.data_file_mixed: @{{path}} is sent as literal text because it is combined with other -d data
warnings.curl.urlencode_file: --data-urlencode {{value}} reads a file and is not converted
